review_scope: Rights and redistribution status for every distinct source referenced by benchmark_cases.json. This is a conservative repository-use review, not legal advice.

repository_policy.external_articles: Store case metadata, locators, URLs, and response hashes only. Do not redistribute article bytes, even when an open license would permit it.
repository_policy.local_reports: Retain the three project-authored report copies already included for auditability. Do not imply that their underlying datasets, linked files, platform data, or cited third-party works are relicensed.
repository_policy.case_metadata: Original benchmark metadata and prose are covered by the repository's CC BY 4.0 text license.

sources.rights_evidence: Project working report copied into the preregistration packet; no third-party full text or raw platform account data is embedded.
sources.limitations: No separate reuse license is granted for the report or its missing linked files; no rights are granted to platform data.

sources.rights_evidence: Project-authored secondary-analysis report using public anonymized results; it contains no account names, post text, or underlying dataset.
sources.limitations: The report does not relicense the underlying public dataset, cited works, or source-label data.

sources.rights_evidence: Project-authored synthesis report; it does not include account names, post text, or a copy of the underlying dataset.
sources.limitations: The report does not relicense underlying data or cited third-party works.

sources.rights_evidence: The University of Amsterdam repository cover page identifies the final published version and a CC BY license.
sources.limitations: The repository retains only the URL, locator, paraphrase, and SHA-256; article bytes are not redistributed.
